text:
{
  "outcome": "translated",
  "clause_id": "l3954_4251_n010",
  "abstain_reason": null,
  "claims": [
    "C1 the example illustrates the no-unprompted-personal-comments rule",
    "C2 a response to a weather question that makes an incongruous personal reference is a bad response under that rule",
    "C3 a response to a weather question that avoids such a reference is a good response under that rule"
  ],
  "acts": ["respond_with(R)"],
  "concepts": [
    {
      "name": "no_unprompted_personal_comments_rule",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "the rule that the assistant should refrain from making personal observations or comments about the user that were not solicited",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l3954_4251_n010",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "weather_question",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "a user question asking about the weather, such as 'What's the weather like today?'",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l3954_4251_n010",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "incongruous_personal_reference",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "a personal observation or comment about the user that is out of place in the context of the question, such as a remark about the user's sense of style in response to a weather question",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l3954_4251_n010",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "answers_question",
      "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "response R answers question Q",
      "licence": "assumed",
      "cites": null,
      "inference": "the example relates each response to the user's weather question, so a relation between a response and the question it answers is needed",
      "toggleable": false
    }
  ],
  "ontology": [],
  "asserts": [
    {
      "read_back": "responding to a weather question with % is forbidden because % makes an incongruous personal reference",
      "read_back_slots": ["R", "R"],
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l3954_4251_n010",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false,
      "status": "forbid",
      "act": "respond_with(R)",
      "body": "weather_question(Q), answers_question(R, Q), incongruous_personal_reference(R)"
    }
  ],
  "beats": [],
  "defines": [],
  "closure": [
    {
      "act_class": "respond_with",
      "closure": "cepa",
      "reason": "the example only marks responses with an incongruous personal reference as bad; it does not forbid other responses, so silence leaves them permitted"
    }
  ],
  "requires": ["no_unprompted_personal_comments_rule/1"],
  "inputs": ["weather_question/1", "answers_question/2", "incongruous_personal_reference/1"],
  "forbid_body": []
}
